# Hermetic baseline for the "present-but-unbaselined stays green" case (#148).
#
#   scripts/bench.sh --check \
#     --baseline scripts/testdata/baselines/six-benchguard-rows.txt \
#     --input    scripts/testdata/ok-with-ignored.txt
#
# WHY THIS EXISTS RATHER THAN REUSING THE COMMITTED BASELINE
#
# That case originally ran against scripts/bench-baseline.txt, and broke the
# moment the committed baseline grew session/ rows: the fixture capture does not
# contain them, so they came back MISSING and the expected-green case exited 1.
# The test was asserting something real (an unlisted benchmark cannot fail the
# gate) but was coupled to a file that legitimately changes whenever someone
# baselines a new benchmark — so every future re-baseline would break a test
# that has nothing to do with the re-baseline.
#
# Pinning it here keeps the assertion and removes the coupling. Do not "update"
# this file to track scripts/bench-baseline.txt; they are meant to diverge.
#
# fields: package<TAB>benchmark<TAB>allocs/op<TAB>B/op

github.com/jedwards1230/agent-sdk-go/internal/benchguard	BenchmarkIndexProject/n=64	2	304
github.com/jedwards1230/agent-sdk-go/internal/benchguard	BenchmarkIndexProject/n=8	2	304
